Warm up the Julia engine

scuba_julia_warmup.Rd

Runs each accessor once on tiny in-memory and BPCells-backed Seurat objects so the first call on a real object does not pay for compilation (about 0.6 s with JuliaCall, even with precompiled code). Called automatically at engine start-up unless options(SCUBA.julia_warmup = FALSE).

Usage

scuba_julia_warmup(objects = list())

Arguments

objects

Optional list of Seurat, SingleCellExperiment or scuba_source objects to warm.

Value

With objects, a named logical vector (one entry per object: TRUE warmed, FALSE failed with a warning naming the object, NA not a Seurat/SingleCellExperiment object), invisibly; otherwise TRUE invisibly (FALSE if the engine is not available).

Details

Pass the objects an application will serve as objects to also wrap each of them and run one expression fetch, so the first user request does not pay for reading the object's cell names and compiling for its exact layout (about 0.1-1 s per object depending on size). A Shiny app should call this once, after loading its objects and before serving sessions.
